run_ml_inference_her: run the ml_inference CLI to perform HER voltage inference on computational and experimental data
run_volcano_plot: run the ml_inference script to generate a volcano plot of PC1 vs predicted voltage
run_parity_plot: run the ml_inference script with cv_results_csv to generate a parity plot of experimental vs predicted voltage
get_computational_df_to_predict: get aggregate energies per bulk material from a CSV or parquet computational file for inference
run_inference_with_el_features: run the ml_inference CLI with add_features to include matminer elemental features in the model
